verified_apis.name: getimagesize
verified_apis.input_api: getimagesize(local SVG file path); PHP 8.5 added SVG dimension parsing with ext-libxml
verified_apis.scope: Root SVG width and height only; no element or raster decoding claim.

verified_apis.name: getimagesizefromstring
verified_apis.input_api: getimagesizefromstring(local SVG bytes); PHP 8.5 SVG dimensions via ext-libxml
verified_apis.scope: Same bundled SVG size parser as getimagesize, exposed through a byte-string API.

no_api_findings.finding: Loads generic XML and returns generic DOMElement nodes. The control loaded, but no SVG-specific PHP DOM object or rendering behavior was exposed; not counted separately.
Documented image formats exclude SVG; the valid local SVG control returned false.

limit: Scoped to PHP 8.5.12 on this host with ext-libxml. Earlier PHP releases do not have the documented SVG getimagesize feature.
